Research complete. I verified the core facts directly (LinkedIn public post pages are readable even though profiles are walled); a second research pass surfaced career/education/personal details I could NOT independently confirm, so I've flagged those below.

## Craig Darling, CISO, Goosehead Insurance

**Disambiguation anchor:** There are at least 10 other "Craig Darling" profiles (an Acrisure Re reinsurance exec, a Scotland lawyer, a Wisconsin wealth advisor, the CEO of an automotive-marketing firm called Darling Local, etc.). The DFW/Goosehead person is distinct. Everything below is scoped to him.

### Who he is (VERIFIED)
- **Current role: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) at Goosehead Insurance.** Confirmed from a posting I fetched directly: Apex Assembly's LinkedIn post (dated 2026-04-14) names "Craig Darling, CISO, Goosehead Insurance" as a featured speaker at the **National Transformation Assembly in Dallas on April 15**, on a CISO panel titled "The Human Firewall: Security Culture, Accountability, and Leadership."
- **Promoted into the CISO seat recently.** As of November 2025 he was still **Cybersecurity Architect at Goosehead Insurance** (confirmed from the Foresite Cybersecurity video-series post "Why Is Your SIEM Still Broken?", filmed at the **North Texas ISSA Golf Championship**). So he moved from cyber architect to CISO within roughly the past year.
- **Deeply embedded in the DFW security community.** He is active in **North Texas ISSA (NTX ISSA)**, the local Information Systems Security Association chapter, and was interviewed on camera at its golf tournament. He is comfortable being approached at exactly this kind of event.
- **LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/craigsdarling** (LIKELY him). Headline reads "Master uncertainty for unfettered happiness." His About snippet: "I've worked in the IT space for 20+ years performing systems architecture, application architecture, and enterprise architecture work, while maintaining my technical depth in emerging technologies." The profile is behind LinkedIn's auth wall (HTTP 999), so I could confirm it only via search snippets, but it surfaces repeatedly and exclusively when searching "Craig Darling" + Goosehead.

### Background and public activity (MOSTLY UNVERIFIED, secondary pass only)
A second research pass returned these. I could not independently confirm them (the aggregator pages that carry them, ZoomInfo, Datanyze, RocketReach, are paywalled/403 to me), so treat as unverified leads:
- Possible **prior Microsoft tenure** (Principal Product Manager and security/cloud roles, heavy Azure certification). If true, this is the single best icebreaker at a Microsoft-hosted event, but I could not confirm it.
- Prior roles listed as RIMA Systems (CTO), Unum, and HMS.
- **Education: University of Maine** (early 1990s).
- **Location: Roanoke, Texas** (DFW). Employer HQ is Westlake, TX.
- **Board member of Level-Up for a Cure**, a DFW cancer charity. The charity itself is real and I verified it: it hosts the **Ryan McPherson Memorial Golf Tournament on Oct 22, 2026 at Cowboys Golf Club, Grapevine, TX**. His board seat is not listed on the charity site, so unconfirmed.
- Spoke at the **ISMG Cyber Resilience Summit Dallas 2026** (unconfirmed).
- Family: wife possibly **Shawni Darling**; a son, **Sage** (also unconfirmed).

### Golf small talk: what's actually safe to use
- **Golf is a real, verified connection.** He plays in the NTX ISSA tournament and was interviewed on the course. Opening with golf will feel natural, not forced.
- **His professional lane is cybersecurity leadership**: SIEM tooling and why legacy SIEM is "broken," cloud-native security, security-by-design for AI/cloud, security culture and accountability (his panel topic). Asking him what he thinks CISOs are getting wrong about AI or cloud security will land.
- **Microsoft angle (high value if confirmed):** if the Microsoft-alum detail holds, lead with Azure/cloud. Verify casually in conversation before leaning on it.
- **Goosehead context:** founded 2003 by Mark and Robyn Jones, HQ in Westlake (DFW), publicly traded, a fast-growing P&C insurance distributor. He is a rising exec at a local success story, a good "hometown" thread.
- **Charity note (use with care, do not ambush):** the Level-Up for a Cure mission is cancer-related and reportedly personal (his own father, and the son of a friend). If it comes up naturally, be respectful; don't lead with it.

### Bottom line
The verified core is solid: **Craig Darling, CISO of Goosehead Insurance, DFW-based, active in the North Texas security community, and a golfer.** The richest small-talk hooks are cybersecurity leadership topics and golf. Treat the Microsoft-alum, University of Maine, Roanoke, and charity-board details as strong leads to confirm in person rather than established fact.
